flags.message: claude-baseline's disclosed retrieval includes another predictor's committed prediction.json for the companion case scotus/9526000124 (read 'for field conventions', also yielding forward signal about the companion application). Forward-mode retrieval is unrestricted and the disclosure was honest, so this is not leakage — but it is a cross-predictor anchoring channel: predictors reading each other's committed outputs weakens the independence of the cohort's forecasts. Maintainers may want the predict prompt to speak to it.

outcome.json records interim_signals.amicus_briefs = 2, but the provisioned 2026-08-24 snapshot's docket text shows five amicus filings on Aug 3 2026 (NSL4A, 56 Former Judges, Bipartisan Former Governors, Society for the Rule of Law, Asian Law Caucus et al.). Immaterial here — the frozen count was 0, so the amicus-increment claim resolves the same either way — but the resolver appears to undercount amicus entries on this docket.
